Ann
A self-proclaimed ace mechanic who travels all over SAND LAND on a large motorcycle. She meets Beelzebub and his friends by chance and joins them on their journey. notes.title: Go beyond SAND LAND and continue into FOREST LAND!
notes.content:
This new world and characters have been imagined by creator Akira Toriyama specifically for the video game and animated series, expanding the world of SAND LAND with new adventures.

[previewyoutube=R-QLnmBpw-k;full][/previewyoutube]
Beyond the dunes and the scorching desert sun, lies a lush and green nation called FOREST LAND. Although peaceful at first glance, this place is governed by a ferocious army opposing SAND LAND. Leading this force is Muniel, fearsome despite his childlike features, he is determined to save his land by getting his hands on a supply of Aquanium, a powerful but dangerous resource, and he will not back down without a fight.

More information HERE:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/fa2d92565c7b2ae418eb6cf8f092dc454f331614.png

Keep an eye out to what's beyond the SAND LAND... And try the demo now!

notes.title: Dive into the desert world with unique characters!
notes.content:
The son of Lucifer, the king of demons, Beelzebub is the Fiend Prince who enjoys video games and machines.
He is a self-proclaimed "evil demon" who plays pranks but never kills people as he actually has a heart of gold. He has physical abilities that are unmatched by humans as well as telephathic abilities that allow him to read peoples minds and speak directly into their mind.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/696de0a009094f108f37f541be23a29ccf92ab76.png
Rao, an elderly sheriff.
Although he is only a human, he has a strong sense of justice and sets out on a journey to find the Legendary Spring to save the people of Sand Land that suffer from the extreme water shortage. Extremely skilled in his tonfas, Rao fights with the strength of a man in his prime. He is also skilled in handling tanks, perhaps due to previous experience... It seems he is holding some secrets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/e5c62d3cea430a49e45ec4e58ff5686e4713e6ab.png
Thief, Beelzebub's chaperone demon. 
He is good at stealing and has a worldly sense. He has knowledge of various things that happened in Sand Land. Thief is a little older than Beelzebub and his appearance is that of an old man, but he has a young curiosity about him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/e4595d946816c82965e93a12e7c716f3b65fafd1.png

notes.title: Dive into a legendary desert world!
notes.content:
Dive into a desert world where both humans and demons suffer from an extreme water shortage. Play as and watch the Fiend Prince, Beelzebub, Sheriff Rao, and demon Thief set off on an adventure in search of a Legendary Spring hidden in the desert.

[previewyoutube=JbKjqVtthPk;full][/previewyoutube]
Playing as Beelzebub, players will be able to explore a vast world accompanied by his unlikely group of demons and humans. Whether roaming in various vehicles, or traveling by foot, players will encounter dangers as well as helpful characters they meet in the vast desert while uncovering SAND LAND’s many secrets. Players will have access to a variety of vehicles that they can customize and equip with loadouts to traverse the desert, overcome obstacles, and take on a diverse assortment of mighty foes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979440/SAND_LAND/
